title: Grayton Beach "Seas the Day" 524 Defuniak Street
h1: Grayton Beach "Seas the Day" 524 Defuniak Street
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Just steps from the beach- Private heated pool **Pool heating is available for this property from October 1 through May 1 for $60 per day**- 2 outdoor showers- 7 adult bikes- Gas grill- 6 parking spots- Complete Clean Linen Participant—ALL linens, including comforters laundered upon every checkout.DETAILS: Escape to Grayton Beach and Seas the Day! Perfect for large groups and family vacations, this 7-bedroom, 7.5-bathroom home accommodates 22 guests. Enjoy leisurely beach living, stunning Gulf views, a sparkling private pool, and beach access less than 500 feet away! Across the street, Chiringo and Red Bar—2 of Grayton Beach’s best local spots—offer delectable bites and delicious drinks.Tranquil blue walls, coastal décor, and an open layout welcome guests inside this 4-story home. Enjoy movie nights together on the living area’s plush sectional and 2 comfy armchairs. The kitchen is equipped to host groups, with high-end appliances, granite countertops, and ample storage space. Tuck into meals at the 2 long tables in the dining area that collectively seat 16 guests, with seating for 4 available at the breakfast bar. Outside, the backyard oasis beckons for leisurely swims, soaks in the sitting spa, and sunbathing—all while the swaying palms provide a peaceful background. When hunger strikes, grill tasty barbecue and dine alfresco at the 6-person patio table as the overhead fan chases away the heat. Guests can wind down with drinks in the pavilion, where soft seating and a wet bar await. A dedicated laundry room and 2 outdoor showers make post-swim cleanup easy. At evening’s end, retire to the primary bedroom with a king bed and private bathroom.A cozy living space with balcony access offers a hangout for teens or a space to unwind on the second level. Sleeping accommodations include a bunk room with 2 twin-over-full bunk beds, a guest bedroom with 1 king bed, and a guest bedroom with 2 king beds and a private bathroom.The third floor features 2 guest bedrooms with queen beds, with 1 bedroom adjoining a bunk room featuring a twin-over-twin bunk bed, making it ideal for families.Ascend to the fourth level, where a charming entertainment space with a TV, card table, bar seating, and couch awaits alongside a balcony with Emerald Coast views and a guest bedroom with a king bed.Seas the Day has all guests need for a fabulous Grayton Beach escape, including parking for 6 vehicles and 7 complimentary adult bikes. For beach access, follow Defuniak Street to Hotz Avenue—the sugar-soft sand starts at the end of the street! Book today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTSFIRST FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bath, LCD/HD flat screen TVSECOND FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Attached Bath , LCD/HD flat screen TV- Bunkroom: Two Twin-over-Full Bunks, Attached Bath- Guest Bedroom: Two King Beds, Private Bath, LCD/HD flat screen TVTHIRD FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: Queen Sleigh Bed, Adjoining Bunk Room, Attached Bath- Bunkroom: One Twin-over-Twin Bunk Bed- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Attached Bath, LCD/HD flat screen TVFOURTH FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Jack & Jill Bath shared with Game Room, LCD/HD flat screen TV*Parties, weddings or events held at the property must be pre-approved in writing by 360 Blue. Fees apply.
